g.title: Wandler_Leg_Board
g.text: Leg Telemetry Module (Addr 0x48, effective 12-bit / 2.0 mV steps)
SCL before SDA! ADDR bridged to GND (0x48); PGA=1 (+/-4.096V)

g.title: Multiplexer_SubBus
g.text: Clock + Data Only (shown for CH0 / LF)
No 3.3V/GND pins on CH0-CH7. SDx color by leg: CH0=BU, CH1=GN, CH2=VT, CH3=OG, CH4=WH, CH5=GY (SCx always YE)

g.title: Controller_Leg_Block
g.text: 4th slot (CH3, CH7, CH11) free for aux/head; V+ = 6.0V servo rail (strictly isolated from 3.3V logic)

g.title: Onboard_RC_Pullup
g.text: 1x 10kOhm Pull-Up (A3 to VDD_3V3) + ADDR to GND strap
